text:
Maya Patel: Dropping a short review thread for the compare table iteration. Main asks: snapshot / export flow, filter preset behavior, and screenreader hints for performance badges. Link: https://redwood.design/iv/compare-snapshot-v2.png
Liam Park: Quick thought 1: users export CSV today but lose the pinned-version info. Should the exported snapshot include pinned version tags?
Nina Torres: Strong yes. Export should mark which row had a model-wide pin and include version id column. Otherwise the CSV is misleading.
Eli Jordan: UX trade 1: adding pin metadata to CSV adds complexity to our CSV schema. Could add a header row like "pin_scope: model". Might be fine.
Kara Gomez: A11y note: CSV consumers include assistive tech users who may rely on the file. Make sure the exported CSV uses readable column names (no icons).
Maya Patel: Good point. Also: filter presets 1 we prototyped "Save as preset" in the UI. Do presets persist per-user or org?
Liam Park: Per-user by default, with an optional share link. We should add copy explaining share link: "Shareable preset: anyone with link can apply this filter set."
Nina Torres: Microcopy tweak: instead of "Save preset" use "Save view" 1 less technical. Tooltip: "Save view (filters & sort)"
Eli Jordan: About the compact/dense toggle: current placement on the far right is easy to miss. Suggest moving it next to the view/save controls since they're related.
Kara Gomez: Keyboard flow: ensure the dense toggle is reachable as a toolbar item (tab stop) and announces state via aria-pressed. Also when rows collapse, focus should remain on the model name, not jump.
Maya Patel: Performance badges: several PMs asked to turn p95 red if regression >20% vs baseline. We need accessible color + icon combinatorics.
Liam Park: Agreed, but prefer a neutral warning icon + color, and also an aria-label that reads "p95 increased 23% vs baseline" for screenreaders.
Nina Torres: Also include a hover/keyboard reveal that shows baseline numbers and window (last 7d). Avoid hover-only.
Eli Jordan: For the pin affordance: current mock uses a small icon on the right. When rows resize in dense mode it becomes invisible. Suggest moving pin into the left column, inline with model name and make it a toggle button with clear label on focus.
Kara Gomez: On-screen reader wording for the pin toggle: "Toggle model pin, currently pinned to version v2.3.1". Use aria-describedby to point to a small invisible hint describing scope (row vs model-wide).
Maya Patel: Export UI: add an option "Include pin metadata" checkbox in the export modal (default on). Also allow "Include performance percentiles" toggle (default: p95 only).
Liam Park: For analytics, track events: export_includes_pin, export_includes_percentiles, save_view_create, save_view_apply. I'll draft events.
Nina Torres: Tiny copy: change modal title from "Export compare" to "Export compare snapshot" so it reads better in inboxes.
Eli Jordan: Frontend note: performance badge popovers should reuse our popover component to get focus trapping and escape key handling for free.
Kara Gomez: Final a11y checklist before next review: CSV column naming doc, aria-labels for badges and pin toggle, keyboard reachability for dense toggle, focus behavior on row collapse, contrast check for warning color.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Liam to draft analytics events + share spec (owner: Liam, due Tue)
- Nina to update microcopy in mock + export modal text (owner: Nina, due Mon)
- Eli to move pin into left column and wire popover behavior (owner: Eli, PR by Wed)
- Kara to run a quick accessibility QA and produce checklist (owner: Kara, due Thu)
- Maya to iterate mock and attach updated PNG to the ticket (owner: Maya, due Fri)
